 Customer Support FAQ
 Document ID: CS-004  |  Version 3.2  |  Effective: 1 January 2026  |  Department: Customer Support
General Questions
Q1. How do I track my order?
Open My Orders in the app, select the order and tap Track. You will see the current status: Placed,
Packed, Shipped, Out for Delivery or Delivered. You also receive an SMS at each major stage.
Q2. Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
Yes, but only if the order status is still Placed or Packed. Contact live chat and request an address change.
Once the order is Shipped, the address cannot be changed and you should contact the rider when they
call.
Q3. What if the rider does not call me?

5.text:

call.
Q3. What if the rider does not call me?
Riders attempt delivery up to 3 times. If you missed the calls, contact support with your order number and
ask for a re-attempt. After 3 failed attempts the order returns to the warehouse and is cancelled.
Q4. I received a different product from what I ordered. What should I do?
Do not use the product. Raise a Wrong Item request within 7 days of delivery with clear photos of the
product, label and packaging. A free pickup will be arranged and a replacement or refund will be issued.
Q5. Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?

6.text:
Q5. Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?
COD is available in most cities for orders up to Rs. 50,000. Some remote areas may be online-payment
only. The checkout page shows the available payment options for your address.
Q6. Are my card details stored?
Card details are processed by PCI-DSS compliant payment partners. Daraz only stores the last 4 digits
and card brand for display.
Q7. I was charged twice. What now?
Share the order number and the transaction screenshot with support. Duplicate charges are reviewed
within 5 working days, and the extra amount is refunded to the original payment method.

Q8. How do I report a fake product?
Use Report Seller on the product page or contact support. Suspected counterfeit items are removed within

Q9. Can I speak to someone in Urdu?
Yes. All support channels offer Urdu, English and Roman Urdu.

Marketplace sellers must hand the parcel to the logistics partner within 2 working days of the order being

5. Delivery OTP
For security, most orders use a 4-digit OTP sent by SMS. The OTP confirms that the customer has
received the parcel. Once the OTP is shared with the rider, the order is marked Delivered and any claim of
non-delivery will be treated as a fraud risk. Never share the OTP before you physically hold the parcel.

If the outer packaging is torn, wet or visibly tampered with, the customer may refuse delivery. The rider will
record the refusal reason and a full refund will be processed. If damage is found after opening, raise a
return request within 7 days.

 Failed Delivery and Rider Conduct Policy
 Document ID: DL-004  |  Version 3.2  |  Effective: 1 January 2026  |  Department: Delivery
1. Delivery Attempts
The logistics partner makes up to 3 delivery attempts on consecutive working days. Before each attempt
the rider calls the customer twice. If the customer does not answer, the attempt is marked failed.
2. After Failed Attempts

After the 3rd failed attempt the parcel is returned to the warehouse

Prepaid orders are refunded after the parcel is received back

COD orders are cancelled with no charge

Customers with 3 or more COD failed deliveries in 90 days may be limited to online payment only
3. Customer Requests a Re-attempt

Customers with 3 or more COD failed deliveries in 90 days may be limited to online payment only
3. Customer Requests a Re-attempt
Customers can ask for a re-attempt or a new time slot through live chat or the Track Order page before the
3rd attempt. Re-attempt requests are limited to one per order.
4. Customer-Not-Available Rules
If the customer asks the rider to come back later, this counts as one of the 3 attempts. Customers may
authorise a family member to receive the parcel by sharing the OTP with them.
5. Rider Code of Conduct

Riders must wear the logistics partner uniform and ID card

Riders must not ask for tips, extra fees or payment beyond the order amount

Riders must not open the parcel unless asked for verification

Riders must treat customers respectfully


6. Reporting a Rider
To report rider misconduct, contact support with the order number and a description. Complaints are
investigated within 3 working days and can lead to warnings, suspension or removal of the rider. Serious
cases are escalated under the Complaint Escalation Policy (CS-002).
7. Lost Parcels
A parcel is marked lost if it cannot be traced for 7 working days after the last tracking update. The
customer receives a full refund within 3 working days of the lost status, or a replacement if available.

5. COD Refunds
COD orders are refunded to the customer's bank account or mobile wallet (JazzCash or Easypaisa), never
in cash. The name on the account must match the name on the Daraz account. See Refund Methods
(RF-003) for the exact timelines.
